item_name: Rothco Universal Clip On Handcuff Key
item_short_desc: Rothco's Universal Clip-On Handcuff Key is designed to fit standard double lock handcuffs. The key’s aluminum body ensures long-lasting durability without adding bulk, while the textured handle offers enhanced grip, facilitating easy one-hand operation in demanding situations. In addition, the easy clip-on design allows for convenient storage and accessibility when on-duty. This universal handcuff key is an essential tool for public safety, security, police, and other professionals requiring reliable handcuff access.
